profile.summary: Improve Your Tomorrow is a nonprofit that works to increase the number of young men of color who attend and graduate from college. It runs in-school mentoring and college-preparation programs starting in middle school, plus support for members in college and a career mentor fellowship. It is based in Sacramento and serves students in California and several other states.
